data.goal: fresh observation pass: find a testable opportunity via live GitHub API probes

argv:
curl -s "https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=is:issue+is:open+label:enhancement+created:%3E2026-03-01&sort=comments&order=desc&per_page=20" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for it in d[\"items\"]:
    print(it[\"comments\"], it[\"repository_url\"].split(\"/\")[-1], it[\"title\"][:90])
"

for q in "dedupe+photos+is:issue+is:open" "batch+rename+is:issue+is:open+label:enhancement" "csv+to+sql+is:issue+is:open" "merge+pdf+cli+is:issue+is:open" "compress+images+is:issue+is:open"; do echo "== $q"; curl -s "https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=$q&per_page=3" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(d.get(\"total_count\"))
for it in d.get(\"items\",[]):
    print(\" \",it[\"repository_url\"].split(\"/\")[-1],it[\"title\"][:80])
"; sleep 7; done

curl -s "https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/search/advanced?site=superuser&sort=votes&order=desc&answers=0&pagesize=10&filter=withbody" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for it in d.get(\"items\",[]):
    print(it[\"score\"], it[\"view_count\"], it[\"title\"][:95])
"

curl -s "https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/search/advanced?site=superuser&sort=votes&order=desc&pagesize=30&filter=!nNPvSNR4(" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for it in d.get(\"items\",[]):
    if not it.get(\"is_answered\"):
        print(it[\"score\"], it[\"view_count\"], it[\"title\"][:90])
"
